"""Repro for GH6744-style bug: center ignored when iterating DataArrayRolling.

Runs with a NumPy-2 compat shim because this old xarray source predates NumPy 2
and the only available venv has numpy 2.5.4. Shim only affects this process.
"""
import numpy as np

# --- NumPy 1.x -> 2.x alias shim (process-local, for importing old xarray) ---
_aliases = {
    "unicode_": "str_",
    "float_": "float64",
    "complex_": "complex128",
    "int_": "intp",
    "uint": "uint64",
    "bool8": "bool_",
    "object0": "object_",
    "NaN": "nan",
    "Inf": "inf",
    "Infinity": "inf",
    "infty": "inf",
    "NAN": "nan",
    "INF": "inf",
    "PINF": "inf",
    "NINF": "-inf",
}
for old, new in _aliases.items():
    if not hasattr(np, old):
        try:
            val = eval(f"np.{new}") if not new.startswith("-") else -np.inf
        except AttributeError:
            continue
        setattr(np, old, val)

result1 = my_data.rolling(x=3, center=True).mean().values

result2 = [window.mean().values.item() for label, window in my_data_rolling]
print("manual    :", result2)

ok = list(result1) == result2
print("MATCH" if ok else "MISMATCH: manual iteration is not center-justified")
